messages:
anjali: CI acceptance-audit job failed after yesterday's RBAC pruning change. validator output shows missing actor fields and a hard reject. gist of error:

```
> audit-validator: ERROR: event 0x8fd4: validation failed: /actor/id: missing property (required)
> details: event.payload.actor is null
```

kevin: saw the job. RBAC change intentionally strips some PII from service-generated events (actor.email, actor.id) for privacy. Are we still requiring those fields in the schema?

maria: Validator currently enforces schema v2 which requires actor.{id,display_name}. Our golden fixtures are v2 too. Two options: make fields optional for backward compatibility, or update fixtures + bump schema version and add migration step in validator.

leo: adding that KMS envelope step might be in the wrong place: if envelope redaction runs before audit enrichment we lose actor metadata permanently. infra logs include entries like `kms.envelope=true` and `metadata.encrypted=true` followed by `enrichment:skip`.

sre-bot: CI: `acceptance-audit` failed (job 382) at 2025-11-12T03:08:21Z. Rerun requested.

anjali: this isn't a flake — reproduces locally with the current pipeline. Proposed immediate plan:
  1) add a compatibility migration in the validator that recognizes a `schema_version` and tolerates missing actor fields with a warning (short term)
  2) update golden fixtures to include a `system` actor placeholder where RBAC strips actor info (short term)
  3) long term: add schema_versioning + explicit migrations in audit-tooling, and fix KMS/enrichment ordering in infra (no silent redaction)

kevin: +1 on schema_versioning. I don't like silently relaxing validation rules in perpetuity. Prefer (3) as long term and (2) as short-term mitigation in CI so customers don't see regressions. Also: add a migration smoke test that simulates KMS redaction in CI.

maria: I'll open a draft PR to: update goldens, add a migration runner in validator, and add a unit test that exercises missing-actor with schema_version="v2-deprecated-actor". Will push by EOD.

leo: I'll take ownership of the infra check for KMS ordering. If redaction is removing fields before enrichment we need to reorder or add a copy that preserves audit metadata. This could be customer-impacting for enterprise tenants who expect actor traces. I'll start an infra follow-up.

anjali: assigning owners: maria -> validator/golden PR, kevin -> CI migration/test harness, leo -> infra KMS ordering + customer impact assessment. I'll file an incident ticket and loop in support/CS if any flagged customers may be affected. Marking as P1 for audit coverage. :eyes:

audit-tool-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-142 by anjali. https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/INC-2026-142

kevin: one more ask — add a unit test in schema-validator that explicitly fails if an event with no actor is produced without a known `schema_version` header. That'll prevent silent regressions.

maria: draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/412 (includes migration runner + updated golden fixtures + a CI smoke job that simulates KMS-redaction). PTAL.

anjali: thanks all. I'll review maria's PR and coordinate the incident communication. If anyone spots customer-facing errors, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
